```lean
theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : x + 1 / x ≥ 2 := by
  have h : Real.cosh (Real.log x) = (x + x⁻¹) / 2 := Real.cosh_log x
  have h' : Real.cosh (Real.log x) ≥ 1 := by apply Real.cosh_ge_one
  rw [h] at h'
  simpa only [mul_two, add_div, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_eq_one_div] using h'
```
